phases.name: stability & rehab prep
phases.focus: Establish safe movement patterns and progressive loading with emphasis on spinal extension control and anti-flexion work.

phases.name: restriction transition
phases.focus: Gradually introduce compound movements with controlled ranges and avoid heavy spinal loading or loaded spinal flexion.

phases.name: strength foundation
phases.focus: Build general strength with emphasis on posterior chain, core stability, and safe loading strategies.

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week general strength with spinal safety"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary general_strength:
    name "General strength with spinal protection for history of L4-L5 disc herniation; no heavy spinal loading; no loaded spinal flexion; progressive loading over 12 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "stability & rehab prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY upper training 60m "Stability & anti-flexion emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank_hollow_hold 3x30s rpe 4 rest 60
          side_plank 2x30s each_side rpe 3 rest 60
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          belt_safe_hard_pull 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY lower training 60m "Spinal extension control and safe loading":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90
          romanian_deadlift_safety 3x10 rpe 5 rest 120
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Anti-flexion and hinge pattern with safe loads":
        warmup:
          banded_external_rotation 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_hinge_to_box 4x8 rpe 5 rest 90
          lat_pulldown_assist 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          farmer_walk 2x30s rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extensions 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Mobility & light conditioning":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bike_sprint_intervals 6x20s rpe 6 rest 40
        cooldown:
          mobility_flow 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY upper training 60m "Controlled loading and extension work":
        warmup:
          banded_overhead_stretch 3m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press_machine 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          assisted_pull_up 3x6 rpe 5 rest 120
          cable_external_rotation 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          mobility_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY lower training 60m "Continued safe loading":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge_accent 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          glute_ham_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          kneeling_quad_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Hinge pattern focus":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing_modified 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          bent_over_row_supported 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          reverse_fly 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60
          planks 3x20s rpe 3 rest 60
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Light conditioning & mobility":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rower_modeled 8x20s rpe 6 rest 40
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY upper training 60m "Stability progression":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          lat_pulldown_assist 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY lower training 60m "Controlled loading":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Hinge & pull balance":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          cable_pulldown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          hollow_hold 3x20s rpe 3 rest 60
        cooldown:
          back_extensions 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Mobility & low-intensity conditioning":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          elliptical 15m moderate
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY upper training 60m "Stability consolidation":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          one_arm_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY lower training 60m "Safe loading progression":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat_assisted 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          goblet_split_squat 3x10 each_side rpe 5 rest 90
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Posterior chain emphasis":
        warmup:
          banded_deadlift_setup 3m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x8 rpe 5 rest 120
          bent_over_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
          planks 3x25s rpe 3 rest 60
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Reset & mobility":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 10m moderate pace
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 2m
  PHASE "restriction transition" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY upper training 60m "Controlled compound introduction":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY lower training 60m "Safe quadriceps loading":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 120
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Progressive hinge/pull balance":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift_high_handles 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60
          ab_wheel 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          back_extension 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Cardio maintenance":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing_machine 15m steady
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY upper training 60m "Load progression with safety":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          pull_up_assist 3x6 rpe 5 rest 120
          cable_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          tricep_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY lower training 60m "Controlled quad/hammies":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat_to_box 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          Romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Hinge + pulls with safety":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120
          one_arm_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60
          farmer_walk 2x30s rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extensions 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Light conditioning & mobility":
        warmup:
          jogging 3m
        main straight_sets:
          cycle 15m easy
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
  PHASE "strength foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 7:
      DAY upper training 60m "Strength basics with safe loads":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY lower training 60m "Posterior chain emphasis":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat_to_box 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          Romanian_deadlift 4x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Hinge strength with control":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          ab_wheel 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          back_extensions 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Maintenance conditioning":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 15m moderate
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY upper training 60m "Progressive overload in upper body":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          pull_up_assist 4x6 rpe 6 rest 120
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY lower training 60m "Strength with safe loading":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Balanced hinge and pull":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          one_arm_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90

          hollow_hold 3x25s rpe 3 rest 60
        cooldown:

    WEEK 8:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Maintenance cardio":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 15m steady
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY upper training 60m "Strength maintenance with form":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
        cooldown:

    WEEK 9:
      DAY lower training 60m "Lower body strength with safe load":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Hinge + pull strength":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          planks 3x40s rpe 3 rest 60
        cooldown:
          back_extensions 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Low-impact conditioning":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15m moderate
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY upper training 60m "Volume build with safety":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150
          pull_up_assist 4x6 rpe 6 rest 120
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY lower training 60m "Volume lower body with control":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat_to_box 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120
          Romanian_deadlift 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Hinge volume & pulls":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          one_arm_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          ab_wheel 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extensions 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Cardio mix":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 15m moderate
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY upper training 60m "Peak upper routine":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY lower training 60m "Peak lower routine":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Power hinge":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          hollow_hold 3x30s rpe 3 rest 60
        cooldown:
          back_extensions 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Maintenance cardio":
        warmup:
          jogging 3m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15m moderate
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY upper training 60m "Deload week upper":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY lower training 60m "Deload week lower":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY hinge/pull training 60m "Deload hinge/pull":
        warmup:
          banded_good_mornings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120
          one_arm_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          ab_wheel 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extensions 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY conditioning training 40m "Final conditioning & mobility":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 12m moderate
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m

NON_NEGOTIABLES
  - no heavy spinal loading
  - no loaded spinal flexion
  - full gym access
